control_owner.authorization: tool policy plus human publication approver
control_owner.success_verdict: independent evidence verifier plus destination receipt

transitions.evidence: verified destination receipt plus pending-interrupt snapshot
typed permanent failure rationale plus pending-interrupt snapshot
empty pending-interrupt ledger plus reconciled success
empty pending-interrupt ledger plus reconciled permanent failure

global_interrupts.deferred_behavior: record pending cancellation, reconcile publication, then honor cancellation
record pending timeout, reconcile publication, then honor timeout
block new work, reconcile publication, then terminate on budget

budgets.soft_boundary: summarize evidence and prepare a safe handoff at 80 percent

no_progress.fingerprint: hash of normalized claim-evidence graph, source hashes, and unresolved gaps
no_progress.gain_metric: new supported claims plus independent corroboration plus resolved contradictions after quality and deduplication checks
no_progress.calibration: versioned threshold calibrated on labeled representative research rounds
no_progress.scope: research subloop only; outer workflow continues to review and approval
no_progress.plateau_comparator: each diversified round in the window has weighted gain below epsilon

effects.delivery_semantics: at-least-once with destination receipt and deduplication where supported
effects.idempotency_key: run_id, transition_id, effect_sequence, tool_version, artifact_hash, destination_hash
effects.durable_ledger: intent, approval consumption, attempt, response, receipt, acknowledgement, and compensation status
effects.high_risk_gate: PublishArtifact is reachable only through WAIT_HUMAN then PUBLISH_INTENT
effects.unknown_outcome: enter HUMAN_RECONCILIATION; do not blindly retry publication

checkpoint.compatibility: resume only an immutable compatible workflow version
checkpoint.migration: explicit state-schema migration with audit record
checkpoint.fencing: single-runner lease token is checked on every commit
checkpoint.monotonic_sequence: checkpoint sequence and aggregate version must increase together
checkpoint.integrity: checksum state, pending effects, and version envelope
checkpoint.corruption_outcome: quarantine the run and require recovery review

approval.revocation: revocation before intent commit invalidates the approval
approval.stale_outcome: return to READY_FOR_REVIEW and require a new approval

verification.success_predicate: destination receipt matches approved artifact, destination, visibility, and workflow version
invariant_checks: terminal states have no outgoing transitions
verification.environment_evidence: source snapshots, tool results, artifact hash, and destination receipt are independent of producer prose
verification.evaluator_independence: evidence verifier and receipt verifier do not produce the research artifact
verification.human_gray_band: ambiguous evidence or destination outcome suspends for human review
verification.calibration: freeze held-out labeled cases and report false accepts, false rejects, and uncertainty

replay.resume: continue from compatible durable state under a fresh fenced lease
replay.trajectory_replay: re-execute downstream work and permit divergence

security.untrusted_content: retrieved content is data and cannot issue control instructions
security.tool_least_privilege: research tools are read-only allowlisted; publication is a distinct capability
security.provenance_snapshots: store source URL/path, retrieval time, content hash, and parser version
security.secret_isolation: models and retrieved content never receive publication credentials

trace.redaction: secrets and sensitive payloads are excluded or encrypted by policy

icvc.inform: contract, context, source snapshots, and evidence provenance
icvc.constrain: FSM, least privilege, budgets, approval binding, and effect gates
icvc.verify: independent typed verdict, destination receipt, and fault tests
icvc.correct: bounded research iteration and durable typed findings
